name: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 241-2023 Equivalent Clean Airflow (ECA) Benchmark Dataset
description: Deterministic engineering benchmark dataset containing 178 calculation vectors evaluating Equivalent Clean Airflow (ECA) demand and delivery under ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 241-2023 (Control of Infectious Aerosols). The dataset models Infection Risk Management Mode (IRMM) across 11 standard commercial, educational, and healthcare space archetypes. It tabulates Table 5-1 baseline clean airflow requirements per person (ECA_p) and per unit floor area (ECA_a), central air handling unit mechanical filtration capture efficiencies across MERV 8 to MERV 16/HEPA tiers (1-3 µm droplet nuclei), in-room portable air cleaner Clean Air Delivery Rates (CADR) with room mixing factors (0.90), and upper-room UV-C germicidal irradiation equivalent clean airflow. Key Columns:- vector_id: Unique calculation vector identifier (ECA-VEC-0001 to ECA-VEC-0178)- space_type: Standard occupancy archetype per Table 5-1- category: Educational, Commercial, Healthcare, Public Assembly, Residential- floor_area_sqft: Usable room floor area- occupants: Design peak population (P_z)- ceiling_height_ft: Ceiling height- room_volume_cuft: Zone interior volume- ashrae_241_eca_p_cfm: Table 5-1 clean airflow required per person (CFM)- ashrae_241_eca_a_cfm: Table 5-1 clean airflow required per sq ft (CFM)- required_eca_cfm: Total required Equivalent Clean Airflow demand (CFM)- required_ach_equiv: Equivalent clean air changes per hour required- outdoor_air_cfm: Delivered pathogen-free outdoor ventilation air (V_ot)- recirc_ai…
